channel.title: Hyperbyte Cloud
channel.description: Notes on HyperbyteDB, InfluxDB v1 compatibility, and time-series engineering.

item.title: From 99M to 1.9M Rows/sec: What Benchmarks Don't Tell You
item.description: A benchmark that drops from 99 million to 1.9 million rows/sec under realistic conditions, and why headline ingest numbers mislead you.

item.title: Scaling chDB Inserts from 5M to 99M Rows/sec
item.description: How we took chDB insert throughput from 5 million to 99 million rows per second: batching, the write path, and where the real bottlenecks were.

item.title: Why InfluxDB Enterprise Pricing Hits a Wall
item.description: Retention policies, continuous queries and replication sit behind InfluxDB's paid tier. What that costs, what HA means for telemetry, and what ships in HyperbyteDB's open-source binary.

item.title: Your Telegraf + Grafana + Alerts Stack, Now on a Database That Doesn't Buckle
item.description: Point Telegraf and Grafana at a different URL and keep the rest of your observability stack. What transfers unchanged, where InfluxQL behaviour differs, and what ships in the open-source binary.

item.title: Run InfluxDB v1 on Kubernetes? Swap the Operator, Keep the URLs
item.description: Replace InfluxDB v1 on Kubernetes with HyperbyteDB's operator. Same /write and /query endpoints, same Telegraf and Grafana configs, master-master replication included.

item.title: High Cardinality Without the Rewrite
item.description: InfluxDB v1 slows to a crawl with high-cardinality tags. HyperbyteDB handles it with columnar storage and ClickHouse—keep your InfluxQL, change one URL, tag everything.

item.title: IoT Analytics at Scale: InfluxQL Without Downsampling
item.description: Run real-time InfluxQL analytics on millions of IoT sensors without downsampling. GROUP BY device_id, rolling averages, and anomaly detection on full-resolution data.

item.title: The InfluxDB v1 Migration Checklist: Which Clients Just Need a URL Change
item.description: Most InfluxDB v1 migration guides focus on Telegraf. Here's the complete client-by-client checklist covering Grafana, custom apps, Python scripts, and Java services—and which ones just need a URL change.

item.title: InfluxDB v1 Compatibility in HyperbyteDB — What Works and What Doesn't
item.description: HyperbyteDB speaks InfluxDB v1 line protocol and InfluxQL on the same endpoints. Endpoint coverage, InfluxQL support, known differences, benchmarks and cutover notes.

item.title: Exporting Historical Time-Series from InfluxDB v1 to HyperbyteDB
item.description: Most migration guides cover updating Telegraf and Grafana configs. But historical data gets left behind. Here's how to export time-series from InfluxDB v1 and load it into HyperbyteDB.

item.title: Before You Trust Our Numbers, Run This — HyperbyteDB Benchmarks
item.description: Run HyperbyteDB's own Criterion ingestion benchmarks in minutes. Walk through line protocol and columnar numbers, understand what's measured, and record your environment before comparing anything.
